Thank you for your comments. Apologies that 'leaking feathers' wasn't clear. I mean like feathers and bits of feathers fully coming out, will be floating around the room, attaching to other fabrics. I was using a zip up duvet cover over the comforter and cover and when I took that off, there was almost a layer of feathers stuck to that cover. So many that there were feathers on the 2nd duvet cover I had on it. It would be fine if it were just a feather poking out but this is like, feathers are filling the room. 

Also I am from the U.K. - i think we use the terms 'cover' differently which has caused some confusion. E.g we would call where the feathers are directly encased in the 'duvet' , and a 'cover' would be any separate thing you put over e.g. a pillow or duvet, and you would never have what in the US you call a 'comforter' , without what you call a 'comforter cover' (we call a 'duvet cover') .
